fusions.name: Felled Trunk
fusions.desc: Fells a trunk across a narrow cone 5 tiles long, dealing 32 damage to everything under it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Rooting Hack
fusions.desc: A chop that sinks sap-laced roots into the target, dealing 7 damage, slowing it by 25% for 2 seconds and leaving it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stacked Deadfall
fusions.desc: Drops a row of felled trunks 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Coppice Growth
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
